notes: Fastned vehicle page chart data (the page embeds a per-percent kW series); Fastned says the curve shows the car on its network with the battery in optimal conditions (around 30 °C), and a colder or warmer battery can charge much slower. Sampled every 5 % plus the first, last and peak points. Fastned does not state the session count, ambient temperature or preconditioning. Fastned page covers the 40 kWh Leaf 2018-2024; applied to 2025 as no change to the pack or charging hardware is known. Second source: EverTV (evercars.com) 2018-2025 Leaf S CHAdeMO test (mild weather, no preconditioning) reports about 45 kW at the start (under 10 %) with a 47 kW peak near 16 %, 45 kW held to the mid-50s, 35 kW at 65 % and 25 kW at 80 %, 10-80 % in 37 min 38 s; this agrees with the Fastned shape (45.6 kW at 60 %, 36.5 at 65 %, 26 at 80 %). Leaf throttles hard when the pack is hot: repeated fast charges are slower (rapidgate). Peak 45.6 kW is 8.8 % under the 50 kW rating (B95 5 % rule not met); EverTV agrees (47 kW peak). Fastned labels this 2018-2024; 2025 carried over.
